purpose: The Savings Account panel is open, showing the player's current total savings, accrued interest, time until the next deposit cycle, and three deposit tier options (Standard, Superior, Premium) to choose from.
full_text: Until Next Deposit 12:11:26. Total Savings: 4,611,000. Interest Rate 6% — 261,000. Please select a savings account option. You can make only one deposit per day. Deposit tiers available: Standard Deposit — 3,150,000 per deposit, Interest Rate +3% (costs 3,150,000 gold); Superior Deposit — 3,600,000 per deposit, Interest Rate +5% (costs 72 gems); Premium Deposit — 4,500,000 per deposit, Interest Rate +6% (costs 90 gems).
